description: This file defines the interface and data structures for a transport channel used in inter-process communication within the Cuttlefish project. It includes the RawMessage structure, a MessageDestroyer class, functions to create messages, and an abstract Channel class for sending and receiving messages.

classes.name: MessageDestroyer
classes.description: A functor class that destroys RawMessage instances, ensuring proper memory management.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Deletes a RawMessage pointer, used as a custom deleter for ManagedMessage.

methods.name: CreateMessage
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a RawMessage with specified command and payload size, returning a ManagedMessage.
